page.title: Waboo migration
page.description: Move Waboo organizations into WaDesk with the existing migration pipeline, now or at a chosen time, and follow each one from here.
page.banner: This panel never connects WhatsApp and never writes to Waboo. A migration always starts with its own full rehearsal that writes nothing, and stops before loading anything if the rehearsal is not clean. Organizations run one after another.
page.superOnly: Only a super admin can run migrations.

form.title: Start a run
form.orgHint: The Waboo organization (workspace) id, which is the Waboo database name. Letters, digits, underscore and plus sign.
form.orgInvalid: Use letters, digits, underscore or plus sign (up to 128).
form.migrateHint: Migrate starts with a full rehearsal and loads nothing if it is not clean. A separate dry run is optional.
form.skipWhatsapp: Don't migrate the WhatsApp number (for testing)
form.skipWhatsappHint: The workspace migrates fully, but its WhatsApp number is not imported or connected.

confirm.title: Migrate {org}
confirm.body: This loads organization {org} into WaDesk. It starts with a full rehearsal and loads nothing if that is not clean; once the load itself starts it cannot be stopped. Type the organization id to confirm.
confirm.label: Type {org} to confirm
confirm.catchupBody: This brings the already-loaded organization {org} up to date: it re-exports from Waboo, loads new rows only, syncs the wallet and verifies the result. It stops if its own dry run is not clean and cannot be stopped once it starts. Type the organization id to confirm.

bulk.title: Bulk migration
bulk.idsHint: One organization id per line, at most {max}.
bulk.collisions: Same client key as another id: {ids}.
bulk.tooMany: At most {max} organizations at a time.
bulk.stopHint: Off by default: a failed organization does not stop the rest.
bulk.sequential: Organizations run one after another, never two at once, because the staging server cannot run two migrations together.
bulk.notReady: {count, plural, one {# organization has} other {# organizations have}} no green dry run from the last 24 hours, so Migrate all is off.
bulk.migrateHint: Each organization starts with its own full rehearsal and loads nothing if it is not clean. A separate dry run is optional.
bulk.skipWhatsapp: Don't migrate the WhatsApp numbers (for testing)
bulk.skipWhatsappHint: None of these workspaces gets its WhatsApp number imported or connected.

bulkConfirm.title: Migrate {count} organizations
bulkConfirm.body: This loads {count} organizations into WaDesk, one after another. Each one starts with its own full rehearsal and loads nothing if that is not clean; once a load starts it cannot be stopped. Type the number of organizations to confirm.
bulkConfirm.label: Type {count} to confirm

readiness.ok: Latest dry run is green and recent. You can migrate.
readiness.okReview: Latest dry run is green but raised alarms to review. You can migrate once you have reviewed them.
readiness.no_dry: No dry run yet. Run a dry run first.
readiness.not_green: The latest dry run is not green. Fix it and run a dry run again.
readiness.stale: The last green dry run is more than 24 hours old. Run a new dry run.

schedule.label: Run at (optional)
schedule.hint: Your time zone: {tz}. Leave empty to start now.
schedule.utc: Your time zone: {tz}. That is {utc} UTC.

error.invalid: Enter a valid date and time.
error.past: Pick a time in the future.

batch.title: Batch of {count, plural, one {# organization} other {# organizations}}
batch.stopOff: A failed organization does not stop the rest.
batch.polling: Updating while the batch is active.

detail.title: Run {org}
detail.polling: Updating while the run is active.

verdict.green: Green: nothing unaccounted for, no integrity errors
verdict.amber: Review alarms: no data is missing, but the verifier raised alarms to look at
verdict.red: Red: needs attention. Do not treat this run as done
